description: One service of an installed plugin, as it was placed.

asks_for.description: What it asks for there, where it says.

config_path.description:
Where inside the container its one configuration directory is mounted.

Resolved rather than optional. The record answers where the directory is, and
a run that re-derived the fallback would answer for a container it did not
write the day that fallback moved.

description.description:
The line its dashboard entry shows beside it: the one its wiring names, or what
the plugin says it does for the operator.

digest.description: The digest that fixes what runs.

fields.description: Its container fields beyond those above.

fronts.description: The service of the same plugin it stands in front of, as an adapter.

health.description: The path it answers over HTTP to say it is up, where its health is asked that way.

hidden.description: Whether its wiring hid it from the dashboard.

icon.description: The icon its dashboard entry shows, where its wiring names one.

image.description: The registry path, carrying no pin of its own.

listens.description: The port it answers on inside the stack's network, where it declared one.

media_types.description:
The media it files, in the stack manifest's vocabulary, which decides what it
comes to in each service that asks for what it provides; none in an older record.

name.description:
What it is called, for a reader, which is what its dashboard entry is listed as;
a record written before this was kept lists it by its id.

native.description: The API it answers the stack's other services in, where it names one.

networks.description:
Networks an older record named for it. Nothing reads them: each service's place on
the networks is derived with the project, and a record written now holds none.

provides.description:
Every core capability this one service fills, which is what makes it a candidate
when the stack asks for one.

Per service rather than read off the plugin's whole list, because a wiring
reaches a service and not a plugin: of a plugin's two services, the one that
fills a capability is the one an ask for it would reach. Defaulted for a record
written before this was kept, which reads as filling nothing — a service nothing
is wired to, rather than one wired to on a guess.

reached.description: How it is reached, or nothing where it has no listener.

reaches.description: Where it reaches outside the machine, where it says.

replaces.description: The stack's own service it moves in place of, where it names one.

service.description: The service's id, which is the name its container is written under.

shape.description: The privileged shape lemonfiber writes for it, where it took one.

speaks.description: Each capability contract it answers as an adapter, as `capability@major`.

starting.description: The digest of the starting files kept for its run proofs, where it has any.

tag.description: The readable name that digest went by when it was installed.

takes_data.description: Whether the library is mounted for it.

upstream.description:
Each field of the `upstream.json` lemonfiber writes for it as an adapter, to the
id of the plugin's secret that field holds.
